summary: Full-stack review of Montez Infobyte mobile mirror. Backend: 10/10 pytest cases pass (health, mobile CMS GET+PUT with admin auth, OTP send/verify happy+wrong, push register, broadcast auth+success). Frontend: Splash → Welcome → Home → Products (search+navigate) → Product Detail → RFQ (prefill+validation) → Contact → Account (OTP dev flow + logout) all verified end-to-end on 390x844 mobile viewport. CMS admin PUT reflected instantly on Home announcement pill. Upstream product fetch returned real polo/T-shirt data; search 'polo' filtered client-side to 9 items. Minor React Native deprecation warnings detected (shadow*, Image.resizeMode, pointerEvents) but no red screen. category chip 'All' testID missing.

ui_bugs.issue: 'All' chip does not expose a stable per-chip testID (e.g. category-chip-all). category-chips-row exists but individual chips can't be reliably tapped in tests.

issues: Search '9 items' counter includes results whose name doesn't visibly contain 'polo' (matches on description/category); consider showing matched term hint for clarity.

react_native_issues.issue: shadow* style props are deprecated; migrate to boxShadow. Reference: /app/frontend/src/theme (shadow.card usage across home.tsx, contact.tsx, account.tsx, product/[slug].tsx footer).
Image style.resizeMode is deprecated; use props.resizeMode. Reference: /app/frontend/app/welcome.tsx bg image and any Image using resizeMode via StyleSheet.
props.pointerEvents is deprecated; use style.pointerEvents. Likely coming from a react-native-web internal on LinearGradient overlays or SafeArea.

action_items: (Optional) Add testID per chip in CategoryChips (e.g. category-chip-<key>) to make Products filter easily testable.
Migrate StyleSheet shadow* -> boxShadow to silence deprecation warnings on Expo web/RN new arch.
Replace pointerEvents prop with style.pointerEvents where applicable (may be inside LinearGradient wrapping).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py `random` import is unused; safe to remove.
MobileCMS response includes stored `_id` because the update-then-refetch flow projects _id out only in _get_cms_doc — verified _id is not in GET response (uses projection {"_id":0}). OK.
OTP verify does not rate-limit; acceptable for dev.
Push register upstream 401 correctly downgraded to registered_local (playbook compliant).
AppContext boot uses Promise.allSettled — resilient to upstream flakiness. Good.
seed_data_creation: Backend PUT test wrote a TEST_announcement_<timestamp> value into mobile_cms singleton to validate live CMS propagation; visible on Home banner announcement pill during frontend test. Push user TEST_user_1 and a broadcast record with title TEST_title were created. Consider cleanup or leave for admin visibility.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Frontend expects `EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL` to be the ingress that maps /api to the local supplementary FastAPI. Upstream products/RFQ/settings/categories come from https://enterprise-supply-1.emergent.host. Dev OTP is hardcoded 123456 and returned in send-otp payload. Admin token 'montez-admin-2026' in `X-Admin-Token` header. AsyncStorage key `montez_welcome_seen` gates splash routing.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs blocking primary flows. Only minor deprecation warnings and one missing testID (category-chip-all).
